chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamadani, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Murazim ibn Hakim, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both. He said:

Betake to going to mosques, for they are the houses of Allah on Earth. Whoever goes to them in a state of purity, Allah purifies him of his sins and records him among its visitors. So increase your prayer and supplication in them, and pray in different spots in the mosques, for every spot will bear witness for the one who prayed upon it on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.الْمَسَاجِدِ: mosques — places of prostration and communal worship
key_terms.بِقَاعٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ: different spots — various locations within the mosque for prayer
key_terms.مُتَطَهِّرًا: in a state of purity — having performed ritual ablution

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about the merit of attending mosques?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq teaches about the spiritual merit of attending mosques. He describes mosques as the houses of Allah on Earth and explains that going to them in purity cleanses one's sins. The Imam also advises increasing prayer and supplication within them and praying in various spots, because each location in the mosque will testify for the worshipper on the Day of Judgment.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
